background: Barclays Bank PLC is the non-ring-fenced bank of Barclays, housing the corporate and investment bank, the international cards business and the private bank, funded by corporate deposits and wholesale markets.
synthesis: All three of the main agencies rate the bank, A+ on average and A+ at the weakest of them, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital reads two ways against the UK majors: CET1 of 12.6% is in the bottom quarter while leverage of 5.5% is in the top quarter. Funding is the weaker side, with NSFR of 112% in the bottom quarter and LCR of 140% below the peer median and down 14 points since 30 Jun 2025, the other three ratios broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The adverse items flagged on 28 Sep 2026 concern a borrower's collapse and the allegations its principal has made against the bank rather than the bank's own standing, alongside earlier reports of repeated outages on a trading risk platform.
